note: Step B0 decisions on the tree counts. Key: "Municipality|ROOT-FILE" (the tree's root file, as in docs/tree-review). Each override: units (the count to use), reason, source (a link or document), decidedOn (YYYY-MM-DD). Applied by scripts/tree-review.js now and by the app at Step B1.

rules.preconsultationOnlyCount: count it, flagged 'estimate (pre-consultation)', proposed only, never committed (decided 2026-10-15)
rules.permitsWhenNoCount: when no file states a count, the units on the building permits placed in the tree count; never for a replacement or model house (tree rule fixed 2026-10-15)
rules.minorFileStatedCount: a minor file's own stated count counts, not only its wording (tree rule fixed 2026-10-15)

chronology.r1: an undated file takes 1 July of the year in its file number, flagged "date from file number"
chronology.r2: an approved site plan / condo / draft plan filed 3+ years before a newer pre-consultation, rezoning or block plan on its land is history, not part of the new tree
chronology.r3: same land, counted once: the latest file (stating its own count) wins when it is the same stage refiled, covers 90%+ of the earlier land, or (no boundary) its wording reads as a resubmission; else the largest stands
chronology.r3Unclear: pairs the wording cannot call keep the largest count (decided: OZ/OPA 24-2 vs SP 25-67, OZ/OPA 10-5 vs SP 21-155)
chronology.r4: a permit issued 2+ years before the file it would sit under is the old building: not placed
chronology.r5: each tree is shown in filing order with backwards steps marked (report only)

categories: count found where the app had 0
splits: separate proposals the app grouped together (unless the count drops by 100+)
drops to 0: a replacement house, no new homes, or the app counted a withdrawn file
new trees and app developments with no live tree
small or well-linked count changes (under 100 units, or not low confidence)
